competency_fulfillment.rationale: I checked each subtraction digit by digit and none of the sampled pairs requires regrouping, so the without-regrouping restriction is genuinely enforced by the generator and not merely asserted.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Two minus shapes are named, yet the two-digit-minus-one-digit case is represented by essentially a single item, the pictured group where 'Taking away 7 trees.' is applied to sixty-nine. Fourteen of the fifteen sampled items are two-digit minus two-digit, so one named sub-case is generated only incidentally.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Count-back instructions are spelled out before the question is asked, the subtractions are carry-free, and the pictured sets carry a written total so a pupil is not forced to count sixty-nine symbols one at a time.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The sample includes number-line movement such as 'The dot is at 48 and it moves backward 30 numbers', large pictured groups, abstract count-back, and an error-checking format, which is the model variety the competency requires.

competency_alignment.rationale: The progression moves from small teens through to values in the nineties while holding the no-regrouping constraint, so what is getting harder is the number size within the exact skill named.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Stems keep both numbers below one hundred, but option lists breach that ceiling twice over, offering 123 against a subtraction from sixty-three and 110 against one from seventy - values that cannot arise from taking anything away.
